title: StandardMaterial3D - Stencil Mode "Custom" with Stencil Flags "Read" and no alpha transparency produces 10x error in the output log
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.5.beta1
Not reproducible in any version before, as stencils were implemented in 4.5.beta1 ([GH-80710](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/80710))

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta1 - Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER (nvidia; 570.133.07) - AMD Ryzen 5 2600 Six-Core Processor (12 threads) - 62.74 GiB memory

### Issue description

Stencils were implemented with the following PR: [GH-80710](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/80710)

When setting the `stencil_mode` to `custom` and then `stencil_flags` to `read`, the following error is printed 10x in the Output log.

```
Set stencil_flags
  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/render_forward_clustered.cpp:4022 - Attempting to use a shader  that reads stencil but is not in the alpha queue. Ensure the material uses alpha blending or has depth_draw disabled or depth_test disabled.
  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/render_forward_clustered.cpp:4022 - Attempting to use a shader  that reads stencil but is not in the alpha queue. Ensure the material uses alpha blending or has depth_draw disabled or depth_test disabled.
  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/render_forward_clustered.cpp:4022 - Attempting to use a shader  that reads stencil but is not in the alpha queue. Ensure the material uses alpha blending or has depth_draw disabled or depth_test disabled.
  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/render_forward_clustered.cpp:4022 - Attempting to use a shader  that reads stencil but is not in the alpha queue. Ensure the material uses alpha blending or has depth_draw disabled or depth_test disabled.
  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/render_forward_clustered.cpp:4022 - Attempting to use a shader  that reads stencil but is not in the alpha queue. Ensure the material uses alpha blending or has depth_draw disabled or depth_test disabled.
  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/render_forward_clustered.cpp:4022 - Attempting to use a shader  that reads stencil but is not in the alpha queue. Ensure the material uses alpha blending or has depth_draw disabled or depth_test disabled.
  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/render_forward_clustered.cpp:4022 - Attempting to use a shader  that reads stencil but is not in the alpha queue. Ensure the material uses alpha blending or has depth_draw disabled or depth_test disabled.
  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/render_forward_clustered.cpp:4022 - Attempting to use a shader  that reads stencil but is not in the alpha queue. Ensure the material uses alpha blending or has depth_draw disabled or depth_test disabled.
  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/render_forward_clustered.cpp:4022 - Attempting to use a shader  that reads stencil but is not in the alpha queue. Ensure the material uses alpha blending or has depth_draw disabled or depth_test disabled.
  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/render_forward_clustered.cpp:4022 - Attempting to use a shader  that reads stencil but is not in the alpha queue. Ensure the material uses alpha blending or has depth_draw disabled or depth_test disabled.
```

Setting `transparency` property to `alpha` disables the errors.
I think simply selecting values in the Inspector shouldn't result in an error, especially not the same error printed 10x. Maybe there is a way to make it less intrusive for the user.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/850e9786-0b89-453b-a798-cc9e56e0296c

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a `MeshInstance3D` node.
2. Assign a `mesh` to the node, e.g. a `CapsuleMesh`.
3. Set up a new `StandardMaterial3D` in the `material` property.
4. Change the `stencil_mode` to `custom` and `stencil_flags` to `read`.
5. Errors

[test-project-stencil-alpha-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20824738/test-project-stencil-alpha-bug.zip)
